Where I found it:
- The kit sets the page frame as `.k-wrap{max-width:1200px;padding:0 24px}` at line 15 of /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lca-website/1fd51a69-02bf-57f1-8228-8c93b25a76bd/scratchpad/docs-wt/docs/redesign/lca-redesign-boards/kit.css.

What the other sources say:
- The decided boards set no wide-screen maximum. Nav-Header-Final draws 1024px and 1280px browsers, with the header row running full width at 24px padding. Home-Final uses `.k-wrap-wide`, which is 1360px.
- The built code is narrower. /home/user/lca-website/src/components/layout/SiteHeader.tsx line 283 uses `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6`. So does /home/user/lca-website/src/pages/AdminEmailPage.tsx line 590, where the newsletter tab lives. With Tailwind 4 that is a 1152px box with 1104px of content.
